layoutBehavior.mobileDrawer: At max-width 760px: min(288px, 86vw), modal dialog, main-shell inert, closed drawer inert, focus trap, Escape dismissal, body lock and focus restoration.
layoutBehavior.connect: Maximum 1160px. Trove-account OAuth client setup and connected apps use 1.5fr / 0.9fr columns, 260px minimum on the latter, 22px gap; columns stack at 1050px. Full-width advanced-token disclosure follows, then example task and collapsed tool reference. Connected-app rows wrap at 600px.
layoutBehavior.account: Maximum 1000px. Paired profile and Google panels, full-width security/data panels; paired password fields. One column at 760px.
layoutBehavior.dialog: Fixed heading plus scrollable body; maximum calc(100dvh - 48px), or calc(100dvh - 24px) up to 760px. Heading/body padding follows docs/DESIGN.md.
layoutBehavior.dataDisclosure: Sticky table headers inside bounded scroll containers. Values over 160 characters show 140-character previews and native details with full text; expanded text scrolls within 18rem. Receipt refs and fingerprints use details; JSON download remains complete.
layoutBehavior.publicStory: Fixed 96px header with 5.5vw gutters; four native-scroll 100svh chapters with a contained sticky scene. At 760px: 76px header, 22px header gutters, full-width copy and source fragments below. Normal-flow fallback and reduced-motion chapters precede source disclosures.
layoutBehavior.signIn: 44% deep-ink story / 56% white form; 400px maximum form. Up to 760px, brand strip plus form at 24px page gutters and 420px maximum.
layoutBehavior.dashboard: Working shell, maximum 1200px; white research-start panel and ink agent panel in 1.65fr / 1fr columns with 270px minimum agent width and 24px gap, stacking at 1050px. Two recent-research/data columns with 30px gap stack at 760px. Persistent agent panel reflects actual connection state; mobile icon/text grid places action below text.
layoutBehavior.workspace: 350px composer beside flexible output, 300px up to 1250px and one column up to 1050px. Explicit requirements and optional AI brief share a labelled mode control; category details disclose required fields and filters. Spending caps retain explicit USD and limit language. Shared editable research starts appear in the left-aligned welcome region, maximum 600px and padding 56px 28px, becoming 30px 4px on mobile. Selection sets explicit requirements and focuses the composer without submission.
layoutBehavior.authorization: Outside the rail: home link above a consent panel in a centered 540px maximum-width column on Chalk Canvas. App name and callback host wrap; actions wrap at 600px. Account, requested permissions and separate payment approval stay visible.
layoutBehavior.catalogue: Two-column offer inventory beside a white guided-start panel, using existing 294px / 260px / 320px aside widths. Below 1050px the guide follows inventory with three equal start columns; below 760px these become divided rows. Labelled Preview actions open source details.
layoutBehavior.publicSources: Available catalogue entries form three divided columns on white between story and closing section; title plus arrow, description, fields, record limit and USD batch price. Padding 100px 5.5vw; at 760px, single column and 64px 24px padding. No category overlines. Links open the corresponding public source preview.

google-sign-in.usage: Official full-color Google G, unchanged aspect ratio, displayed at 20px. Origin metadata remains embedded in the PNG.

convergence.usage: Native Three.js points, lines, and layered document frames, lazily imported by the public landing; no new raster asset.

narrative.overview:
Trove is a working research marketplace: an ink navigation rail establishes orientation, chalk surfaces hold the source inventory, cobalt marks selection and action, and amber marks navigation highlights and public entry actions. The result is compact, orderly, and specific to a tool for investigating data.

The approved replacement of the former green identity retains the application and local fonts. Prepared regulatory datasets appear as ordinary paid products; source scope, original attribution, upstream reuse rights, exact USD prices, and human approval remain legible. The system uses functional line icons and geometry, with concise copy and progressive disclosure for detailed terms. Supply assumptions belong in the hackathon pitch, while the interface identifies the actual PayPal payment environment.

The approved Data Convergence public introduction expands this world into deep ink, porcelain, and amber, with larger, lighter Manrope type and real Three.js particle geometry. Its spacious Persuade mode leads into the established Operate mode for authentication and research. This is an extension of the Technical Atlas: the working application retains its navigation, compact density, and exact-price controls. The scene adds no raster asset or invented partner identity.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent ink navigation with reachable account and agent controls.
Cobalt actions and selection against quiet white inventory panels.
Editable research starting points shared across dashboard, catalogue, and workspace.
Manrope headings, Inter controls, and tabular financial values.
Flat information surfaces with depth reserved for controls and overlays.
A spacious deep-ink introduction with amber entry actions and source fragments that gather into context.

rules.name: The Action Cobalt Rule
rules.body: In the working application, use cobalt to express an action, selection, or the established heading emphasis; preserve amber for its navigation-highlight, agent-panel icon, and sandbox roles. Deep-ink public surfaces use amber entry actions and headline emphasis; pale public surfaces return to cobalt.

rules.name: The Stable Amount Rule
rules.body: Financial values retain tabular numerals and an explicit USD context; changes in value must not shift a comparison column's rhythm.

rules.name: The Reachable Rail Rule
rules.body: Preserve the scrollable middle and pinned account footer; never make navigation depend on a tall viewport or reduced browser zoom.

rules.name: The Flat Inventory Rule
rules.body: Keep inventory card geometry fixed on hover; use border, a restrained ambient shadow, and selection treatments to communicate interaction.

rules.name: The Readable Story Rule
rules.body: Keep every story chapter, source disclosure, entry action, and skip route usable when animated geometry is unavailable or motion is reduced.

dos: **Do** preserve ink navigation, cobalt actions, and amber navigation and public-entry highlights across routes.
**Do** keep the rail callout and account controls reachable at normal zoom and short laptop heights.
**Do** use local Manrope headings, Inter body copy, and tabular financial values.
**Do** pair state color with text, preserve visible keyboard focus, and honor reduced motion.
**Do** keep exact-price approval, the actual payment environment, permissions, and source provenance visible where relevant.
**Do** keep the public story readable in normal flow when motion is reduced or graphics are unavailable.
**Do** label future domains explicitly and keep available-source details tied to actual catalogue metadata.
donts: **Don't** restore green as the brand theme; reserve green for success states.
**Don't** invent partner logos, testimonials, provider verification, AI calls, or payment success.
**Don't** remove quote scope, licence, expiry, included commission, or the user's exact-price approval step for visual simplicity.
**Don't** propagate inherited decorative eyebrows or the smallest legacy metadata sizes as new design primitives.
**Don't** add card hover lifts, hard offset shadows, or a thick decorative border to the Connect example brief.
